notes:
kr8 0.4.9: This round queues messages for busy agents by default, seals agent keys on disk on Windows, recovers replies sent while an agent's bridge was stopped, keeps delivery markers when turns overlap, adds forums to the phone, points the download-by-hand links at downloads.kr8.app, merges the first upstream catch-up (177 block/buzz commits), and fixes two desktop defects the release smoke run found (an undone Canvas wire stayed drawn; Primary+Shift+M closed the @-menu). It is the first release after the kr8.app cut-over.
